questions.question: What is the error code for Xū Bù (Empty Stance)?
What are the deduction points for Xū Bù (Empty Stance)?
questions.answer: Deductions are applied when: 1) Thigh of squatting leg is not parallel to the ground, 2) The heel of supporting foot is raised off the ground.
